SBP: *Missed appointment policies may differ by institution, discipline, and by age of patient; learners should be aware of how missed appointments are addressed and documented within their institution. Clinicians working with individuals with eating disorders should be aware that patient may miss/cancel appointments when their symptoms are worsening to avoid potential consequences (e.g.  getting an exercise/activity restriction or being referred to a higher level of care) or because they are embarrassed that they are struggling. Because a Taylor is losing weight, a change in her current treatment plan or a higher level of care may be warranted*.
PBLI: Learners report back on their research of local eating disorder treatment programs.
